mission.posting: Colleagues of a valued client have been disrespectful, and need to be sent a message. Destroy their recently created server backup.

email.subject: Intimidation Tactics
email.body:
Greetings Agent,
A Colleague of ours has recently been overstepping their bounds, in a most disrespectful manner. We wish to send them a message.
Our information shows that they have recently completed a company-wide backup and stored the data on a separate server. Without damaging their current working copy, we believe the removal of this archive to be a sufficient signal to them. You can find the target information attached.
-#CLIENT#
